defects: Drops the essential hypothesis `f.IsFinitelySemisimple` entirely — without it the equivalence is false in general (e.g. a non-diagonalizable nilpotent endomorphism has its generalized eigenspace at 0 equal to the whole space while its eigenspace at 0 is proper), so the produced statement is a different, generally-false proposition rather than the gold's actual claim.
Narrows the setting from an arbitrary commutative ring R and module M to a field K and a vector space V, changing the generality of the theorem.
Adds an extra `FiniteDimensional K V` hypothesis not present in (or required by) the gold statement.

Uses `Module.GeneralizedEigenspace f λ` (a fixed-order generalized eigenspace) rather than the gold's `maxGenEigenspace` (the stabilized/eventual generalized eigenspace obtained as a union over all orders), which is a different mathematical object relevant to triangularizability.
